prd_summary: Cross-functional operational pipeline executing sequential and interleaved tasks across Autocad, Blender. Requires strict state continuity, rigorous verification of intermediate deliverables, and accurate tracking of task interruptions and resumptions.

active_tickets.title: Autocad: Draft Structural Wall Polylines & Calibrate Dimension Lines
active_tickets.acceptance_criteria: Outer perimeter polylines enclosed, dimension tolerance under 0.05m.

active_tickets.title: Blender: Rig 3D Scene Geometry & Connect PBR Material Shaders
active_tickets.acceptance_criteria: Mesh normals unified, base color texture linked, transforms normalized.

autocad.validation_rule: Outer perimeter polylines enclosed, dimension tolerance under 0.05m.

blender.validation_rule: Mesh normals unified, base color texture linked, transforms normalized.

domain_constraints: All intermediate work-in-progress must be saved before switching application contexts.
When an interruption occurs, the primary task state must be preserved and cleanly resumed.
Final outputs must be validated against ticket acceptance criteria.
